title: Brisket is missing from Texas menus. A Democrat blames Republicans.
description: Vicente Gonzalez releases a new ad connecting high beef costs to the loss of an important South Texas tradition.

title: GOP senator blocks bill to stop Trump from demolishing Kennedy Center
description: The bipartisan effort to ban the demolition of presidential memorials was thwarted in the Senate by an objection from Sen. Mike Lee (R-Utah).

title: This Senate Democratic candidate is making a play for RFK Jr.’s MAHA supporters
description: Abdul El-Sayed unveils a health-focused agenda to persuade Michigan supporters of the Make America Healthy Again movement to back his campaign.

title: Democrats coalesce around a message about the cost of corruption
description: Their message accuses Republicans of flagrant corruption, tying the attack to the billions President Donald Trump has made during his second term.

title: $10 for a gallon of gas has red Alaska thinking about a Democratic senator
description: Mary Peltola hopes to unseat Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan in a race all about prices, federal aid and Donald Trump.

title: Tennessee to execute a woman for first time in over 200 years
description: Christa Pike was convicted in a brutal 1995 killing committed when she was 18. Advocates pushing for her life to be spared point to abuse she suffered as a child.

title: How Trump’s sweeping changes are remaking Washington
description: No modern president has done more to personally reshape the nation’s capital.

title: Trump administration says it's scaling back fuel efficiency standards for new cars
description: The Trump administration is weakening Biden-era fuel efficiency standards for new cars and trucks.

title: Pete Buttigieg discusses Trump administration's rollback of fuel efficiency standards
description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg about the Trump administration's rollback of automotive fuel efficiency standards.

title: News organizations ask court to bar White House enforcement of access ban
description: Three news outlets that President Trump banished from White House grounds asked a federal court to block the ban until the case is resolved.

title: DOJ probe into Trump foes sees another prominent departure
description: Kurt Olsen, who previously worked as Trump’s election security czar, resigned from the so-called “grand conspiracy” investigation Monday.

title: FEMA can’t condition security grants on election changes, judge says
description: The Trump administration had sought to limit anti-terrorism funding for local governments that didn’t check the citizenship status of voters.

title: The Senate passes the Protect College Sports Act, but the bill's future is unclear
description: The bill's supporters, which include the NCAA, say it will tame what they call a "Wild West" era of college sports as litigation chips away at long-held rules around eligibility, transfers and pay.

title: Texas governor declares emergency to bring down fuel prices
description: Gov. Greg Abbott, in a tight reelection race, allows for commercial use of diesel normally reserved for agriculture.

title: Andrew Bailey, No. 2 at FBI, resigns in latest shake-up at bureau
description: Bailey, the former Missouri attorney general, was hired for the leadership role about a year ago.

title: White House to reopen part of Lafayette Square after eight months
description: Administration officials are still pursuing plans to build a permanent fence around the park.

title: The 9 Senate seats most likely to flip party control in November
description: Democrats need to win several races in red states to win back the Senate majority. Here are their best chances.

title: Could a far left candidate win a midterm race in a red state like Florida?
description: Angie Nixon, the Democratic U.S. Senate Candidate in Florida, is running from the far left — raising questions about whether such a campaign can work in a red state like Florida.

title: After mistrial, Pirro says she’ll bring Trayon White bribery case to new jury
description: The D.C. Council member was charged with taking bribes from a city contractor who handed him envelopes of cash during four meetings in 2024, all of them secretly videotaped by the FBI.

title: Trump dined with the Anthropic CEO who called for AI slowdown
description: The president’s first one-on-one meeting with Dario Amodei followed months of tensions.

title: In Iowa, Republicans feel the heat and try to motivate ‘frustrated’ base
description: The political environment for the party has led to widespread alarm. “It feels like it could be a wipeout,” one strategist said.

title: Trump says he has an off-ramp to his biggest political problem. He refuses to take it.
description: There is nothing holding back Republican political fortunes this year more than the war that President Donald Trump started with Iran.

title: Senate Republicans make a final legislative push ahead of the midterms
description: In their last week in Washington before the elections, GOP lawmakers are pressing their party to do more to address the cost of living.

title: Trump aims to leave a physical legacy in D.C., bulldozing norms along the way
description: President Trump has brought his New York real estate background to the White House. But experts say D.C. is a very different historic and legal landscape — and worry about the precedent he could set.

title: What to know about the $810 million in spending canceled by President Trump
description: President Trump announced plans to cancel $810 million in congressionally approved spending, a move that some in his own party are calling illegal.

title: Taxpayer-funded Trump administration ads raise questions about their legality
description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with former White House ethics czar Norman Eisen about the ethical and legal questions raised by new Trump administration advertisements, which are funded by taxpayer money.

title: White House expands taxpayer-paid ad campaign boosting Trump
description: The taxpayer-funded campaign borrows the president's political rhetoric as the White House defends the spots as “public service” announcements.

title: This Texas crooner could help Democrats win Congress, one quinceañera at a time
description: Bobby Pulido would be the only member of Congress with a Latin Grammy to his name. That comes with its upsides and downsides.

title: In Knoxville, cheers for Trump — and some quiet doubts
description: The president, booed at other big sporting events this year, drew mostly cheers at Neyland Stadium. In the parking lots, some of his own voters had misgivings.

title: As Congress debates college sports, athletes-turned-senators have a seat at the table
description: The Protect College Sports Act is on the brink of passing in the Senate, where a handful of former college athletes who are now senators on both sides of the aisle have an extra say in the debate.

title: Ohio governor's race: Ramaswamy and Acton clash in rare Democratic pickup opportunity
description: The Ohio governor's race pits former presidential candidate Vivek Ramaswamy against Democrat Amy Acton, a former state health advisor. Democrats see a chance to win a state that usually votes Republican.
